description: Render any incoming 3D Mesh in the 3D view. The single terminal for all … to 3D Mesh nodes.
instructions: TERMINAL — renders any incoming 3D Mesh (from a '… to 3D Mesh' node, e.g. Footing / Staircase / Space to 3D Mesh) into the 3D view. Generic: every node that produces a Mesh feeds this single terminal. No parameters; wire a Mesh into the input.
